profile_text.body:
Repurpose, founded in 2017, operates repurpose.io, a platform it describes as the "#1 automated content repurposing and distribution platform." The service is aimed at creators and businesses who want to publish video content consistently across multiple platforms, including Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, without manually managing each channel.

The company's core product, tracked under the Video Generation and Editing category, handles content distribution automation, multi-platform publishing, and workflow automation, and offers API access. The site notes that users can publish ten videos for free without a credit card, with paid plans available to unlock additional accounts, higher limits, and premium automation features. No litigation, patent filings, or regulatory records are held for the company.
